description: Substrate-only prediction of Q_β(n) from CAL-1 (m_e) and CAL-2 (q_0), via the single-wrap closed form Q_β = m_e · |q_0² - 2 q_0 - 1| · (q_0 + 1) / (2 q_0³). This is a PREDICTION witness (companion to the CAL-3 calibration witness cal-3-q-beta.witness.json); the substrate value is NOT yet wired as a CAL replacement. Per the cohomological audit (docs/audits/2026-05-24-q-beta-droppability-cohomology.md), the framework can in principle drop CAL-3 once the tower-summation closure lands (Workplan 2 Phase 2); until then the +0.18% residual vs CODATA is recorded here for L2 dashboard visibility and audit-trail purposes.

parameters.role: Substrate prediction of hadronic Q-value, using CAL-1 + CAL-2 inputs only. Parallel to (not replacing) the CAL-3 calibration witness.

data.residual_attribution: Brane-tower truncation at N=0. Exact tower-summed E_0 (Li_2^q form, Workplan 2 P2) is expected to close the residual to within 1ppb.
downstream_consumers: L2 dashboard: per-observable-100x-status.witness.json (new row 'Q_beta-substrate-2CAL' for visibility)
Cohomological audit cross-check: this prediction is the candidate replacement for the CAL-3 input pending tower-summation closure.
data.tolerance_vs_consumers: All downstream production mass-prediction consumers have ≥ 4% MAE on β-decay sector observables; the +0.18% substrate-Q_β residual is well within these tolerances. The 1ppb gate (per-observable-100x-status.witness.json) is the ONLY consumer the substrate prediction would fail today; that closure is the tower-summation workplan item.
